directive: Treat CivicState as watchlist until operator confirmation and market validation replace assumptions.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch brief]; see the PR's POM record
one_liner: AI-assisted civic letters with citations; real repo, watchlist until paid demand is proven.
planningMethod: Preserve existing CivicState narrative, distinguish implemented code from aspirational market proof, and label all external quantitative claims as assumptions.

customer.definition: United States residents with civic concerns who need researched, citation-backed letters routed to officials.
segments: future nonprofits or HOAs after citizen workflow validation

market.sam: $387,000,000 [assumption: TAM adults x 10% willing digital-paid use x $15]
market.som: $1,935,000 [assumption: SAM users x 0.5% early reach x $15]
market.notes: All population and behavior inputs are assumptions because this run had no network access.

streams: future higher-touch review only after validation
future API access only after citizen workflow validation

financialModel.revenueBuild: paid campaigns x $15 AOV [evidence: current tiers]
revenueAssumptions: Paid conversion reaches 3% [assumption: preserved planning gate]
Full-spread uptake is excluded from upside until observed [assumption]
costAssumptions: Initial backend hosting is about $96/month [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]
sensitivityTests: Conversion at 1% cuts revenue by about 67% [assumption: arithmetic]
Deliverability below 85% pauses launch [assumption: planning gate]
Variable cost at $3/order preserves margin but may hide support burden [assumption]

holes.hole: Users may not pay for something they can do free.
holes.mitigation: Charge before delivery and track preview-to-checkout conversion.
holes.residualRisk: High until paid beta data exists.

holes.hole: Government domains may suppress AI-assisted bulk-like mail.
holes.mitigation: Warm domains, monitor bounces, and pause on complaint signals.

holes.hole: Legal advice, lobbying, defamation, privacy, or threat boundary failures could be existential.
holes.mitigation: Disclaimers, moderation, audit logs, and counsel review.
holes.residualRisk: Medium-high because boundary facts are case-specific.

strategy: Narrow to researched constituent communication, keep nonpartisan framing, and validate payment plus deliverability before expanding.

goToMarket.firstWedge: small nonpartisan beta around concrete local civic issues

operatorWorkflow.routine: review flagged submissions, monitor deliverability, monitor treasury and payments, update assumption ledger

constraints: operator confirmation required before business pitch

aiWorkGovernance.disclosures: AI disclosure and not-legal-advice language are present in drafter code.
aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Researcher is instructed to use only provided search results and citation verification strips failures.
aiWorkGovernance.humanReview: Flagged moderation and all-citation-failure paths require operator review.

assumptionLedger.claim: Users will pay $15 [evidence: current tier midpoint] average order value.

assumptionLedger.test: replace with survey and funnel data

assumptionLedger.claim: 3% conversion [assumption: planning gate] is a continuation gate.
